text:
eva_curation: Quick heads-up
during the qbringup canary we saw a pile of 1-3 token non-English snippets flagged as 'ambiguous' in promptset-west.

joel_infra: Can you drop a sample?

eva_curation: Punted 50 -> s3://curation/samples/3735000000/shortfrag. Many are punctuation or urls.

marie_label: If labelers see lots of those they'll tag as insufficient_context and our golden gets skewed. We should filter by canonicalized length first.

khoa_ops: I can run a quick dedupe+normalize pass: strip urls, collapse punctuation, run lang-detect. Want me to run on entire promptset-west snapshot?

eva_curation: Yes, but snapshot first. Make read-only and add tag ingest_v=legacy-2025-11.

canary-bot: Canary note: qbringup7b_v1 -> v2 showed MultilangRecall drop 0.76 -> 0.62 on promptset-west before normalization.

joel_infra: I'll create snapshot promptset_west_snap_3735000000 and run normalize-shortfrag pipeline. ETA 1h.

marie_label: I'll prep a 150-item human review batch with instructions: prefer "insufficient_context" for ambiguous tiny tokens; mark "near_duplicate" if canonical string repeats.

eva_curation: Approved. Hold golden updates until review results. React :thumbsup when done.

khoa_ops: 2705 snapshot created and normalize run started.

canary-bot: Interim: after normalization recall improves to 0.72. Final report pending.
